summary: Fixed two docker-py API bugs: (1) removed host_config= kwarg from containers.create(), inlined host config fields (mem_limit, nano_cpus, network, binds, port_binding) as flat create kwargs; (2) fixed list_containers() label filter format from dict to list of 'key=value' strings. Removed _build_host_config method. Updated 4 unit tests to match new flat-kwarg assertion patterns. All 60 tests pass.
